mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs and higher risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue visibility and earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST × RSAFS) fails to predict returns with Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return pattern occurs in less than 45% of interaction-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 4.5% periods, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for three consecutive months, manufacturing contraction reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates persistent inflation without monetary accommodation, increasing equity risk premiums and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL × FEDFUNDS) fails to predict returns with Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative return pattern occurs in less than 45% of interaction-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth regimes (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% annualized), a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals demand recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue visibility improves.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth < 1.5% annualized periods, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
